scope: Bounded diagnostic EFI boot after native CMPXCHG, RDTSC, CLD/STD and register bit-test changes.
normalization: Home-directory prefix replaced with <HOME>; original digests retained.
findings: Reached Linux early initialization and exhausted the 1.5-billion-instruction diagnostic budget.
Byte memory CMP and memory BTR are measured fallback hotspots; the result does not establish that boot is stuck.
limitations: Smoke runner lacks the dorycfg share needed for its requested DORYCFG-BOOT-SCRIPT-START marker. The marker cannot qualify readiness in this composition.
A prior diagnostic used 3 billion instructions to reach /sbin/init. Production userspace qualification requires the real configuration share.
No accelerated GPU, installed desktop, or end-to-end performance claim.
